defaultPrompt: Help me plan an authorized security review of this repository. Identify the threat model, likely trust boundaries, scan scope, evidence needed, and honest coverage limits.
Review this code change for security regressions and trace each concern to source evidence. Prioritize practical attack paths and distinguish verified issues from hypotheses.
Triage these security findings, explain what the evidence proves and what remains unknown, and suggest minimal fixes for human review.
interface.longDescription: Plan authorized security reviews, review code changes, triage evidence-backed findings, and produce prioritized hardening guidance. This is an advisory workflow and does not itself execute Codex Security scans.

name: codex-security-advisor
description: Guided security review workflows inspired by OpenAI Codex Security for authorized repositories, diffs, findings, and hardening plans.
